text:
GENERATE BURST K7-H1-aery — Hades-language variant of the E07V F04 scene in register H1 (tapered hand-drawn line + painted fill), plate only (a matted character is composited afterwards). task_id "K7-H1-aery".

Deliver EXACTLY ONE image, one image_gen call, LANDSCAPE. Name: out/k7_H1_aery.png. NO retries: one call; calls_used must equal 1. Image 1 is the LAYOUT reference only.

DESCRIPTION (use it verbatim as the content of the call):
Keeper of Hours — HADES-LANGUAGE SCENE PLATE, register H1. LANDSCAPE 1536×1024. Image 1 is a LAYOUT reference: the F04 AERY / OBSERVATORY TOWER: an open-air stone terrace high in the clouds — a great brass armillary sphere on its plinth at the upper-right, a broad compass-rose inlaid in the paving, stairs rising to the upper-left, an arched doorway at the right, low stone parapets, mountains and cloud beyond. Hades-language re-imagining: the same terrace as a single tight ARENA seen from a STEEP elevated camera (about 60°, looking well down), the compass-rose as a bold geometric ground pattern in slate and brass filling the floor; saturated jewel-toned light — GOLD from the armillary, a cold TEAL glow from the cloud-light at the parapets, a violet seam at the doorway; strong graphic shadows; banners and hanging brass instruments framing the edges. SCALE ANCHORS: the doorway/gate is two men tall, the workbench/plinth is waist-high, the floor pattern's bands are one stride wide — the room is built for a standing figure about one-sixth of the frame height. NO characters, NO creatures, NO text, NO UI. Register: HAND-DRAWN painted 2D in the manner of a modern hand-animated action game — a confident dark contour line drawn by hand with visible taper and varying weight, painted fills in clean planes inside the line, restrained texture; the line carries the pose. It should look like one frame of hand-drawn animation, not a rendered illustration. The floor is the play surface and fills the lower two-thirds of the frame. Light: key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, dark low-value ambient, readable shadows never pure black. Fill the whole canvas; no border, no vignette. Do NOT copy the reference's rendering or brushwork — re-draw the room in this register.

Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/ with the exact name above and compute its sha256. No code. No other files. No web. No agents.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "K7-H1-aery"): images = the file with prompt, references (role + path), elapsed_s; calls_used = 1; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns naming anything you could not honour. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: LAYOUT reference (our own E07V F04 scene panel): same room, props and camera position, re-drawn in the Hades language and register H1; do not copy its rendering
